previous_platform_feedback: docs/fts_33682_feedback.json; associated with 45831f2 by submission order, not this candidate

token_microbenchmark.unit: microseconds per TOKENIZE inside SQL BENCHMARK

full_original_benchmark.notes: Every phase uses the unchanged original script and reloads all rows and all three indexes.

reused_data_original_benchmark.notes: Same final 20000-row corpus for every phase; unchanged original defaults.

reverse_order_query_microbenchmark.validation: All 500 outputs in every group checked against 8001 / 11000 / 7332 / 20.

method.process_cpu_clock: Whole-process utime+stime, including background threads, from /proc/PID/stat at 100 Hz.

profiling_basis.purpose: Historical IK samples motivated examining repeated partition selection and charset comparisons; paused debugger samples are not precise CPU percentages.

binary_provenance.notes: Initial token microbenchmark used the first binary. The final source only braces/indents the fallback loop; all eight original SQL reports, query follow-up, final differential and 25 regressions use the final binary.

correctness.native_ps_protocol: Earlier extra --ps-protocol failures on both versions remain unpassed and were not rerun. Normal-protocol SQL PREPARE/EXECUTE is covered by passing regressions.

installation_and_closure.known_native_ps_protocol_limitation: Earlier first-SQL failures on both old and new versions remain unpassed; not rerun in this round.

adoption_decision.action: retain and submit the IK range lookup implementation
adoption_decision.supporting_evidence: 13.64% lower IK internal wall time and 13.43% lower process CPU; reused-data original IK SQL improves in both pairs (5.54%, 3.94%), mean 4.75%; both full runs improve both IK build metrics (means 4.41%, 3.35%).
adoption_decision.negative_evidence: Full-run IK SQL improves only 0.38% on average, with the second candidate slower; full-run BENG SQL is 11.11% slower. Query reports have negative values; reverse-order CPU follow-up retains approximately 1.16% slower English CPU, 0.85% slower Chinese CPU and 0.38% slower mixed CPU. This is a targeted IK improvement, not a demonstrated all-metric speedup.
adoption_decision.query_claim: No query speedup is claimed; the small measured regressions remain part of the tradeoff.

limitations: Only two original-script runs per version for each affinity/load mode. These are shared-host measurements without exclusive CPU or frequency control.

Original benchmark reports print the modified checkout HEAD (8ceff71) for both executables. Use the immutable executable paths, SHA-256 checks and source-patch identity for binary provenance, rather than the printed report HEAD/git_dirty fields.
CPU pinning reduces scheduling variation but does not isolate host interference; changed SQL timings on unchanged BENG paths are retained, not normalized away.
Do not infer a platform score or substitute internal SQL BENCHMARK timing for end-to-end timing.
The eight original SQL reports retain all 168 sample records; the complete internal measurements retain 48 token and 48 query timed groups.
Unicode differential covers every valid BMP scalar and sampled supplementary text/dictionary contexts, not every possible string.
Future unsorted or overlapping cache ranges fall back to the original scan after initialization checks; valid current dictionaries use ordered byte lookup.
The three earlier rejected DaaT trials and other previously documented correctness/PS limitations remain in their original evidence packages.
